acceptance_predicates.description: A fresh user completes setup, benchmark, recording/replay, and comparison with a small number of commands.
Commands default to human-readable text and provide machine-readable --json output.
Wizard and errors explain selections, defaults, development-only warnings, and next actions.

definition_of_done: Fresh-user transcript and executable runner pass on both repositories.

inputs.description: Existing task acceptance, evidence requirements, and development-only constraints.

outputs.description: Strict-schema task specification and generated coordination projections.

gates.description: All existing acceptance predicates and definition-of-done checks pass without weakening thresholds.
